ticket: #37 box 6 — real-Electron empty/task-page navigation, multi-task selection and view geometry

configuration.disclosure: Set by the harness as the documented operator configuration; without it production refuses every page/open (fail-closed).

seeded.taskRoot: isolated temp dir; real task.json written by the production task-store serializer

loopbackPages./a: real page served by this harness on 127.0.0.1
loopbackPages./b: real page served by this harness on 127.0.0.1

driven.pageOpenTaskA: real Desktop 浏览器 panel: fill 任务页面地址 + click 打开任务页面 (renderer -> shell/taskOp -> Host -> main gateway)
driven.pageOpenTaskB: main browser gateway page/open (human actor) — no Desktop control switches task while a page covers the window
driven.pageClose: main browser gateway page/close (human actor) — the Desktop exposes no close control
